name: Yoga
tagline: Shibuya in 15 minutes and Shinjuku in 25 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 34.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 34.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32.8 m to 44.3 m, a difference of 11.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 東急ストア 用賀店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 日産厚生会 玉川病院, about 18 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 公立学校共済組合関東中央病院, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line.
congestion: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池尻大橋→渋谷, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Sakura-Shimmachi; for lower rent, Yoga.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Yoga in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Yoga. To Tokyo, for instance, Sakura-Shimmachi is 3 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥8,000 more at Sakura-Shimmachi. On safety, Yoga comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Kaminoge; for how close the centre is, Yoga.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Yoga in a straight line. Kaminoge has the Tokyu Oimachi Line, a different set from Yoga. To Shinjuku, for instance, Kaminoge takes 11 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 less at Kaminoge. On the number of places to eat out, Yoga comes out ahead.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
瀬田貫井線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
